sa_pegu.design: Pegu palace courtyard in the 1550s, gilded Shwemawdaw pagoda rises above teak palace roofs. Bayinnaung in his red royal silk and Burmese gold crown stands before a carved throne, a calm white elephant with decorative gold chain nearby, Portuguese mercenaries carrying matchlocks to one side. Grand diplomatic encounter, warm humid afternoon.

sa_lanxang.design: A Lan Xang delegation arriving at Ayutthaya palace in the 1560s, decorated elephants, the elderly Lao monk in saffron carrying palm-leaf scriptures prominent in front, young Lao king in white silk and a pointed gold crown beside the delegation. A subtle dreamlike golden That Luang stupa glimmers in distant clouds, symbolizing the planned monument. White palace walls, tropical greenery, ceremonial hospitality.

sa_cebu.design: Cebu coast in 1565. A timber palisade of Fort San Miguel rises beside the charred remains of a deserted village, a Spanish galleon anchored in the blue bay. Raja Tupas with Visayan tattoos, gold jewelry and red headband stands with folded arms on a low hill. An opened small wooden chest in the foreground holds a modest carved Santo Nino child Jesus statue. Legazpi and a few soldiers inspect the palisade below.

sa_urdaneta.design: Acapulco bay in 1565, exhausted Spanish galleon San Pedro finally at anchor, its weathered sails slack. Gaunt Augustinian navigator Urdaneta in black robe steps carefully down a gangplank using a walking staff, tired sailors follow. High green coastal hills, welcoming harbor boats, golden morning light. A delicate non-labeled curved line in sea mist suggests the long northern Pacific return route, subtle and secondary.

sa_ayutthaya.design: Ayutthaya during the 1569 siege, moonlit rivers encircle walled temple city, distant Burmese camp torches stretch along the far bank. In foreground a small low wooden riverboat quietly carries fleeing families, bundles and an elderly Thai artisan hugging a small black lacquer box inlaid with golden lotus. Restrained fear, dignity, silver moonlight and distant amber firelight, no violence.

sa_manila.design: Pasig river mouth at Maynila in 1571. Bamboo palisades and small bronze lantaka cannons defend a riverside settlement. Chinese junks lie by the shore. Young Raja Sulayman in a turban and crimson silk stands upright on a long carved karakoa warboat, looking toward distant Spanish sailing ships. Wide tropical bay, tense afternoon, detailed local maritime culture.

md_wrestle.design: Thang Long palace forecourt around 1525, lively Vietnamese sand wrestling ring. Tall handsome muscular adult Kien, tanned skin, black hair in a topknot, black-lacquered smiling teeth, wearing a modest traditional wrestling loincloth and sash, extends a friendly invitation from the ring. Under a red parasol in the background, pale young emperor Le Cung Hoang in an oversized yellow dragon robe sits beside broad-shouldered Mac Dang Dung in red official robes. Enthusiastic townspeople, drums, warm daylight.

md_huyen.design: The quiet edge of Thang Long palace forecourt after the wrestling crowd disperses, around 1525. Adult court attendant Huyen in jade-green crossed-collar silk gown, black silk hair wrap and black-lacquered teeth holds a folded parasol and a small herbal medicine packet, approaching the viewer with a hopeful but worried expression. Carved wooden palace doors and red parasols behind her, intimate eye-level composition, soft late-afternoon light.

md_guns.design: Red River wharf at Thang Long around 1526. Handsome strong Kien, now a palace guard with red tunic loosely worn, carries two wooden matchlock cargo crates on one shoulder. Broad-shouldered Mac Dang Dung in red brocade official robe examines an unloaded early matchlock angled safely away. Soldiers unload crates from a trading ship, woven baskets, brown river and tiled roofs, moral unease under bright tropical daylight.

md_kitchen.design: Dusk at a Thang Long riverside palace kitchen and adjoining wharf, 1527. Adult attendant Huyen in jade silk under a plain dark hood shelters a frightened but resolute twelve-year-old Vietnamese royal boy in humble fully covering cotton kitchen-servant clothes, soot on his cheeks. She keeps one protective hand on his shoulder while looking toward an awaiting merchant ship. Shadowed kitchen doorway, cooking pots, distant red palace banners, quiet escape planning, no violence.

md_wharf.design: Midnight escape at the Red River wharf in 1527. Kien, tall muscular Vietnamese guard with topknot and red tunic, holds a torch and discreetly waves a merchant ship through the checkpoint, exchanging a knowing smile toward its deck. Stern red-cloaked guard captain with bamboo-scale armor and long spear watches from behind. Wooden watchtower, torch reflections on dark water, hidden passengers unseen below deck, cinematic suspense.

md_mariver.design: Dawn at the reed-filled Ma River estuary, Thanh Hoa, 1527. White-bearded old general Nguyen Kim in worn armor and brown woven raincape kneels respectfully before a fully clothed twelve-year-old royal boy stepping from a fishing boat. On the boat adult Huyen in jade-green gown holds out a small tortoiseshell comb as a farewell gift toward the viewer. Three torches glow in morning mist, quiet relief and gratitude.

md_throne.design: Mac Dang Dung's coronation in Thang Long Kinh Thien hall, 1527. Broad-shouldered former fisherman Mac now wearing a gold-yellow dragon robe receives a ceremonial cup before the throne. Pale twenty-year-old former emperor respectfully presents the folded royal regalia to one side. Rows of civil and military officials bow on stone paving beneath red columns, gold banners without lettering, solemn atmosphere of a dynasty changing.

md_flag.design: Thuan Hoa wharf in 1533, fishing boats and distant mountains beneath a clear warm sky. Adult Huyen, visibly a few years older but the same jade-gowned woman, sun-kissed face under a brown woven raincape, runs joyfully toward the viewer across the wooden pier with a travel bundle, smiling with black-lacquered teeth. Small restored Le royal banner flutters behind, no readable marks. A reunion and a new voyage.

md_rope.design: Quiet Red River fishing wharf around 1541. Adult Kien, broad-shouldered tanned Vietnamese fisherman and former wrestler, dark hair tied up, wearing an open plain work tunic and cotton trousers, holds a short frayed hemp rope coil in both hands, gazing toward the viewer with a thoughtful sad smile and black-lacquered teeth. A repaired fishing net and departing trading ship behind him, sober historical keepsake scene, soft misty morning.

sm_abreu.design: Malacca docks in late 1511, three Portuguese sailing vessels preparing to sail east, sailors load provisions and rolled charts. Antonio de Abreu in a weathered red silk vest studies the route, cheerful brown-bearded Francisco Serrao clasps hands in farewell with stern black-bearded Magellan in old breastplate. Tropical harbor bustle, wooden planks, sails against a bright morning sky, a friendship at the start of a long voyage.

sm_banda.design: Banda Islands nutmeg trade in 1512. Local orang kaya merchants in fine patterned wraps and headcloths display fresh nutmeg fruit split to show scarlet mace and brown seeds, baskets and sacks piled by a wooden waterfront market. Portuguese captain Abreu with a rolled sea chart listens respectfully to a local merchant. Nutmeg trees and volcanic island across turquoise water, natural maritime meeting, no modern objects.

sm_wreck.design: Turtle Island Nusa Penyu in the Banda Sea, 1512. A broken wooden junk lies tilted in shallow turquoise water near pale rocks. Francisco Serrao in a sea-bleached shirt and small cross leads nine exhausted castaways toward a rescue boat. In the distance a low pirate craft approaches, its bare-chested captain with iron-ring necklace visible at the prow, tension without active fighting. Salt haze, wreck timbers, tropical afternoon.

sm_korakora.design: Hitu beach, 1512, two impressive long outrigger kora-kora boats with ranks of paddlers approach opposite sides of a sandy meeting place. Adult Boki Naira with bronze skin, long black hair bound by gold thread and clove buds, elegant local silk and jewelry, confidently interprets for brown-bearded Serrao. A Tidore envoy with red headcloth and gold earring gestures from the other prow. Tropical shoreline diplomacy, warm sunlight, highly detailed island boats.

sm_ternate.design: Ternate royal courtyard in 1512. Sultan Bayan Sirrullah in white turban and gold-edged silk jacket welcomes brown-bearded Portuguese Serrao, who wears his weathered shirt and small cross. Adult Boki Naira in local gold-trimmed silk interprets beside them. Modest timber palace, carved posts, wedding textiles and clove branches, Gamalama volcano above lush gardens, hospitable diplomatic atmosphere.

sm_cloves.design: Lush clove grove on Gamalama volcano, Ternate, 1513. Adult Boki Naira with copper-brown skin and long black hair tied with gold thread and clove buds smiles as she offers a fresh clove twig with small crimson unopened flower buds toward the viewer. Fine locally woven silk and gold earrings, soft dappled sunlight, volcanic slope and distant turquoise sea framed by glossy green clove leaves, intimate and inviting.

sm_letter.design: Ternate wooden house veranda at dusk, 1513. Warm-hearted brown-bearded Francisco Serrao in sea-bleached shirt and small cross hands over a folded wax-sealed letter toward the viewer. Adult Naira with black hair bound in gold thread and clove buds stands nearby holding a clove branch. Oil lamp, rough wooden table, sea chart with indistinct marks, clove trees and Gamalama silhouette beyond. Warm friendship across distant seas, no readable writing.

sm_reply.design: A modest Iberian port-side chart room around 1515. Forty-year-old Magellan, weathered face, salt-flecked black beard, tired eyes, worn dark doublet and old breastplate set aside, reads a wax-sealed letter from his friend Serrao beside an open sea chart and brass dividers. His expression changes from exhaustion to quiet resolve. An Atlantic harbor beyond the window, golden sunset, close intimate composition, all writing indistinct.

sm_mourning.design: Clove grove in Ternate in 1521, a simple fresh grave beneath the trees. Adult Naira wearing a modest flowing white mourning garment, her recognizable long black hair still tied with gold thread and clove buds, scatters clove buds on the earth and holds a last sealed letter. Tearful but dignified face, filtered morning light, Gamalama partly veiled in mist, quiet grief, no corpse or violence.

sm_brunei.design: Brunei river water village in 1521, wooden stilt houses and bustling floating market, baskets and small boats alongside a Chinese junk. Visayan merchant sailors in woven headcloths and patterned wraps exchange animated news with travelers, one gesturing toward the open sea. Wooden walkways, palm leaves, warm sunset ripples, detailed Southeast Asian river trade, human-scale eye-level scene.

sm_cebu.design: Sugbu Cebu coast in April 1521. Tattooed Raja Humabon wearing gold earrings, woven headcloth and a newly received small wooden cross speaks beside a planted wooden cross. Stern Magellan in worn breastplate and young slender chronicler Pigafetta with quill and notebook listen. Local families observe at a respectful distance, three European sailing ships anchored beyond outrigger boats, warm daylight, tense diplomatic aftermath of baptism, no caricatures.

sm_mactan_night.design: Mactan beach on the night before the 1521 battle. Handsome adult Visayan warrior Bulan, long black hair in red headband, geometric tattoos from shoulders to wrists, gold-inlaid front teeth, holds a bamboo spear and looks toward a visiting boat. His elder Lapu-Lapu, a dignified older tattooed local chief, sits by a small fire behind him. Moonlit shallow reef, villagers preparing shields, thoughtful calm before a battle, no injuries.

sm_mactan.design: Wide view of Mactan reef at dawn on 27 April 1521. Knee-deep luminous shallow water prevents the large European boats from reaching shore. On the left Magellan in a worn breastplate leads a small group of weary men withdrawing toward boats; on the right Visayan defenders led by tattooed adult Bulan with red headband, woven shields and bamboo spears stand firm on the shoreline. Sea spray, pale dawn, distant village, dramatic but non-graphic confrontation, no blood or visible injury.

sm_feast.design: Cebu waterfront feast on 1 May 1521. Long bamboo tables beneath a thatched pavilion, fruit, rice and clay cups, tattooed Raja Humabon and Portuguese captains Joao Serrao and Duarte Barbosa among uneasy guests. Foreground viewpoint from an escaping small boat looking back, a worried young Malay interpreter in a simple cotton tunic steps aboard while a distant Portuguese captain reaches toward the bay. Tension and urgent departure, no killing or injuries.

sm_bulan.design: Mactan village landing after the 1521 battle. Handsome adult tattooed Visayan warrior Bulan, long black hair under a red headband, bronze skin and gold-inlaid smile, steps aboard a departing wooden trading boat carrying a bamboo spear and a modest woven travel bundle. Bright tropical water, family and an elderly local chief waving from the beach, hopeful adventure, no armor or European dress on Bulan.

sm_naira.design: Deck of a departing wooden trading ship in the Visayan sea in 1521. Adult Boki Naira, bronze skin, long black hair tied with gold thread and clove buds, wears a modest white mourning shawl over her patterned island silk. She holds an old folded letter and a small clove sprig while looking west with a faint hopeful smile. Billowing sail, luminous ocean, distant tropical islands, the beginning of a new life, wind gently lifting her hair.

sj_padrao.design: Sunda Kelapa pepper wharf at Ciliwung river mouth in 1522. A newly raised small pale stone padrao with a simple carved cross and unlettered coat-of-arms stands near pepper sacks. Adult Ratna, honey-brown skin, long black hair tied with a jasmine strand, red batik sarong and gold earrings, interprets between her generous older father in an iket headcloth and Portuguese envoy Henrique Leme holding a rolled treaty. Tropical bamboo pier, hopeful diplomatic promise, no legible inscriptions.

sj_muster.design: Banten harbor in 1527, Fatahillah with white turban and green band, slim face and short beard, stands on the prow of a Javanese sailing vessel surveying a gathering fleet of prahu with plain green pennants. An elderly Javanese religious scholar in simple white robes advises him nearby. Mangrove shore, ranks of paddlers, sailcloth and traditional kris at his waist, serious military preparations, no battle or modern flags.

sj_kelapa.design: Sunda Kelapa harbor at the mouth of the Ciliwung on 22 June 1527. Pepper warehouses, palm trees and bamboo piers flank a lonely pale stone padrao with a simple cross. Older harbor official Tumenggung in patterned iket headcloth, bare upper torso and gold armbands, stands beside the pillar holding a traditional sword, looking toward approaching green-pennant ships. Sunda spearmen behind a bamboo palisade, harbor bell, tense overcast daylight, no active violence.

sj_jasmine.design: Night aboard a wooden trading ship off Sunda Kelapa, 1527. Adult Ratna in red batik sarong and fitted period wrap blouse, jasmine tied in her long black hair, stands by the rail offering a faded jasmine strand and a rolled palm-paper rubbing, looking toward the viewer with relieved trusting eyes. Her family's small boat recedes upstream behind her. Warm lantern light on honey-brown skin, silver river reflections, quiet promise and gratitude, no readable text.

sj_late.design: Jayakarta harbor in late 1527. Damaged Portuguese sailing vessels withdraw beyond a sandbar, a broken mast and torn sails clearly visible. Salt-bearded Duarte Coelho in a torn dark cloak stands aboard one vessel looking back. On a separate near-shore pier Fatahillah in white-and-green turban watches beneath plain green pennants. Tropical river mouth, rough sea, the failed arrival of a fleet five years late, no injuries or burning people.

sj_market.design: Malacca Chinese herbal market alley in 1526 under the distant shadow of A Famosa stone fort. Adult Kumala, 23-year-old Malay palace attendant, long graceful neck and glossy dark eyes, black hair in a high gold-pinned bun, yellow silk baju kurung mostly concealed by a plain cotton sarong shawl, counts silver coins at an apothecary stall. Dried herbs, ceramic jars and bamboo baskets, wary hopeful glance toward the viewer, humane everyday historical scene, no readable shop signs.

sj_kampar.design: A simple bamboo royal room on the Kampar river, Sumatra, 1527. A frail elderly Malay sultan lies resting fully covered under yellow silk bedding. Dignified beautiful queen Tun Fatimah in yellow baju kurung and gold-thread shawl sits at his side gently tucking his hand under the cover, sorrowful resolute eyes. Adult attendant Kumala with high gold-pinned bun kneels near the doorway, river light through woven walls, intimate grief and dignity, no medical gore.

sj_prahu.design: Off Malacca at sunset in 1528. A sleek Malay prahu draws alongside a larger trading ship. Battle-scarred admiral Hang Nadim, strong tanned man in a red headband, steadies the prow while adult Kumala in yellow silk baju kurung and gold-pinned high bun climbs carefully toward the larger ship. Royal drums covered in cloth and traveling bundles aboard the prahu, orange light across the strait, secret urgent request, no fight.

sj_nobat.design: Johor river upstream in 1528, mangroves open onto a newly built timber palace with palm-thatched roof. A clearly fifteen-year-old Malay prince in yellow headcloth and fully covering royal silk sits beneath a yellow parasol, holding his late father's sheathed kris in both hands. Royal nobat drums and silver trumpets sound nearby, courtiers kneel on the riverbank. Queen Tun Fatimah and adult Kumala watch with relieved proud expressions, golden morning, a kingdom reborn, no readable script.
